title: Crash "GPUVM fault detected" on Arch Linux, AMD Radeon 6600
body:
### Tested versions

Happening in 4.5.1.stable.arch_linux.

It started recently, I think more recently than installing 4.5.1, so it might have been triggered by a system/driver/kernel upgrade.

`vulkaninfo` reports driver version 25.2.7.

The Arch build [links to system libraries](https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages/godot/-/blob/main/PKGBUILD?ref_type=heads) rather than using Godot's bundled ones, but I don't think it would make a difference in this case, compared to the official binaries.

### System information
